priorityList: Ensure Shadowform is active at all times.
Cast Halo on cooldown to trigger Archon effects and begin your burst cycle.
Activate Voidform and Power Infusion simultaneously; use all offensive Trinkets and Potions during this window.
Cast Void Blast on cooldown whenever available (Archon's primary priority).
Cast Shadow Word: Madness if it is about to expire, if you are nearing maximum Insanity (65+), or if you have a Mind Devourer proc.
Cast Tentacle Slam if Vampiric Touch is missing/refreshable on your target or to prevent the ability from reaching 2 charges.
Cast Void Torrent on cooldown, provided your primary DOTs (Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain) are currently active.
Cast Shadow Word: Death if the target is below 20% health or if your Shadowfiend/Mindbender is active to trigger Inescapable Torment.
Cast Mind Blast to generate Insanity and prevent charges from capping.
Cast Mind Flay: Insanity whenever the proc is available.
Manually cast Vampiric Touch if Tentacle Slam is unavailable and the DOT is about to expire.
Channel Mind Flay as your primary filler when no other abilities are available.
